notes.title: New Engine and more!
notes.content:
After repeated requests to improve the optimization and correction of errors associated with errors or so. "black screenshots", we decided to move the game on the new engine.

 The new engine will provide us with new solutions, so you easily can deal with the optimization, and the fact that it is regularly updated by the authors, to solve problems with the game.

Anticipating questions: Yes, to be able to sell the game on the new engine, we need to buy a license, and it's already done.

Let us hope that this will solve the problems some people running the game. We do not want these people felt cheated that spent money on the game you can not play.

After moving the game to the new engine you will be able to see:
[list]
[*] New types of zombies,
[*] New weapons,
[*] New game mechanics,
[*] New shooting mechanics,
[*] Maps,
[*] A new improved store
[*] Better improvements
[/list]
and many more!
